report.direction_method: Increase is positive; actual unchanged targets are excluded. Predicted change > 0 is increase, otherwise decrease/non-increase. ROC-AUC uses continuous predicted price minus observed origin price. Undefined metrics are null. Identical origins per model; validation selection never uses test.
report.methodology: Weekly mean of reported daily median across grades. No target interpolation. Chronological 60/20/20 usable-origin boundaries, train targets purged before validation. Test trees refit every four eligible origins using targets observed at the block origin. ARIMA/SARIMA fixed pre-test parameters filtered with past-only data. Sparse weeks produce eligible-origin samples, not continuous daily forecasts.
